description: This Java source file defines the ConnectPacketAuthHandler class, which handles extracting username and password credentials from MQTT CONNECT packets for authentication within the Hono framework. It integrates with tracing and external authentication providers.

classes.name: ConnectPacketAuthHandler
classes.description: A handler for extracting credentials from MQTT CONNECT packets, facilitating device authentication in the context of Hono, with tracing support.

methods.name: parseCredentials
methods.description: Extracts credentials (username and password) from an MQTT CONNECT packet contained in the provided context, performs validation, tracing, and returns a Future with the credentials JSON object or an error.

methods.name: ConnectPacketAuthHandler
methods.description: Constructor initializing the handler with an authentication provider and a tracer.
